scripts.dev: npm run build-types -w shared && (npm run dev -w frontend & npm run dev -w backend)
scripts.build: npm run type-check && npm run build-types -w shared && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w shared && npm run lint -w backend && npm run lint -w frontend
scripts.lint:fix: npm run lint:fix -w shared ; npm run lint:fix -w backend ; npm run lint:fix -w frontend
scripts.type-check: npm run type-check -w shared && npm run type-check -w backend && npm run type-check -w frontend
